key_points: Walks a long way to school and often arrives too tired to concentrate.
Told a teacher she felt low; the teacher listened but had nobody to refer her to.
Found that talking with two friends after class helped more than anything else.
Wants a room at school where a student can sit quietly for ten minutes.

quotes.text: Nobody at school is trained for this. They care, but they do not know what to do next.
She asked for a quiet place to go, not a lecture.

wants_changed: One trained adult per school whose job it is to listen, and a quiet room that is not the sick bay.

key_points: Left school for a year to work when a parent lost their job.
Came back through a bridging class run by a local group, not the school.
Says the hardest part of returning was the assumption that he had been lazy.

quotes.text: I did not stop wanting to learn. I stopped being able to afford it.

wants_changed: A way back into school that does not punish the year you were away.

key_points: Missed most of a term after a long illness in the family.
The school sent worksheets but nobody asked how she was.
A neighbour who is a retired teacher helped her catch up.

quotes.text: The homework arrived every week. The questions never did.

wants_changed: Someone from school to check in when a student disappears for more than a week.
